caption: The drawing depicts a single stylized floral object with a green vertical stalk, topped by a cluster of light yellow leaf-like shapes radiating from the top. Around the base of the radiating shapes, there is a dark red, curled, ribbon-like structure. The flower is centrally positioned inside a pink square frame that has a jagged, wavy border, which is then bordered by a brown outline. This inner pink frame is placed within a larger, more geometric, multi-layered border composed of alternating rectangles in shades of teal, dark blue, and red-pink, outlined with brown lines. The background outside the rectangular borders is off-white, and the number "16" appears in small gray text in the bottom left corner.
title: Plate 16: Wheat Sheaf, Altar Panel: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
